description: Fort Collins Stormwater Rate History is a dataset listed in City of Fort Collins open data portal (opendata.fcgov.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Fort Collins. History of stormwater rates in Fort Collins. This includes a breakdown of each change and where the rate change is applied, where applicable. Coverage: Fort Collins. The portal files it under the category Environmental Health. Its tags are rate change, utilities, ordinance, historical. The table has 9 columns. Attribution on the portal: Utilities. The portal shows 2020-09-12 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-fcgov-com-portal.
